proposals.title: Ship a one-command H session sweep (kill zombies before demo)
proposals.what: Add a sweep.sh (or /admin/sweep route) that GETs /api/v2/sessions?status=running and DELETEs each, then prints quota active count. Run it <2 min before demo and after any aborted rehearsal.
proposals.why: H caps at 3 concurrent sessions; a single leaked/zombie session (crash between start and delete) silently blocks discovery OR the negotiation money-shot. The plan documents a sweep but it is not coded anywhere — under stage pressure a copy-pasted curl pipe is error-prone.

proposals.title: Make explicit that the desktop negotiation needs a REAL inbound WhatsApp message
proposals.what: Rename/annotate the UI 'Owner replied' button and document that in desktop mode the agent reads the screen (main.py:203) and only replies to an actual unanswered owner message — the reply hint does not put text on screen. Put the friend on the critical path with a co-presenter backup holding the owner phone.
proposals.why: Presenters may click 'Owner replied' and wait, but the desktop turn reports awaiting_owner because no real message is on screen. This is the single most likely on-stage stall.

proposals.title: Fix README/code drift on contact surface (desktop app vs Chrome WhatsApp Web)
proposals.what: Edit README:31 to state the default is the WhatsApp desktop app (CONTACT_MODE=desktop), not Chrome WhatsApp Web via ~/.hai/chrome-profile. Keep the browser path documented only as an env-gated insurance option.
proposals.why: The stale README could send the operator to log into the wrong WhatsApp surface the morning of the demo, wasting setup time and leaving the actual desktop app unprepared.

proposals.title: Enforce single-process run mode + a /health-based go/no-go preflight
proposals.what: Document and script: run npm run dev (single Node process, the discovery store lives in globalThis), one uvicorn, one concierge; then gate the demo on curl localhost:8000/health returning desktop_ready:true, accessibility:true, screen_recording:true, whatsapp_installed:true, hai_key_present:true.
proposals.why: next start with multiple workers would not share the in-memory discovery store, dropping in-flight session ids. Revoked macOS Accessibility/Screen-Recording (reset by any python3.13 update) makes keystrokes fail silently with no error — /health is the only pre-check.

proposals.title: Harden the Telegram front-door: deleteWebhook + single consumer + kill strays
proposals.what: Before starting concierge, call deleteWebhook and pkill -f concierge/main.py so exactly one getUpdates consumer runs; add a tiny space/retry between the shortlist photo sends to avoid a Telegram 429 dropping an image.
proposals.why: Telegram getUpdates is single-consumer; a leftover process or a set webhook causes 409 conflicts and the bot appears dead. The shortlist burst (text + 3 photos + map) can trip the per-chat rate limit with no retry in send().

proposals.title: Pre-warm CDN/geocode paths and isolate the shared browse binary
proposals.what: Warm the UI once on venue wifi so Leaflet/cartocdn tiles and Nominatim geocodes cache; do not run any gstack /browse or /qa skill during the demo since make_map_image shells out to the same single browse daemon.
proposals.why: The concierge map image depends on the shared browse binary plus unpkg/cartocdn tiles and OSM geocoding — all internet + single-daemon. Contention or a blocked CDN drops the map image (non-fatal) and can grey out the UI map tiles.

proposals.title: Rehearse the network-loss and 429 fallbacks; keep a cued backup video
proposals.what: In rehearsal, kill wifi mid-discovery to confirm the cached fallback + badge flip, and force a negotiation 429 to confirm it fails visibly. Since negotiation has no cached fallback, keep a 2-4x recorded clean run cued at 0:00 on a second space, plus a paired phone hotspot.
proposals.why: Discovery degrades gracefully to cached listings, but negotiation and Telegram do not degrade — on quota/429/network loss they simply fail. The only safe net for the money-shot is the recorded video and a hotspot.
